weather_report:
As the sun begins its slow descent above Boston, the sky dons a veil of gentle clouds. There's a hint of humidity lingering in the evening air, with scattered whispers of showers and even the possibility of sprightly thunderstorms, should the evening tempt fate. The temperature is holding steady in the sultry embrace of the 70s, with a soft south wind offering a slight reprieve. While a mere 20% chance of rain seems innocuous, it could materialize in fleeting bursts—a kiss of summer rain, perhaps, just enough to moisten the pavement but not to dampen spirits.

Tomorrow beckons with a mix of hope and clouds. A slight chance of showers dances around mid-morning, transforming into a more robust possibility as the day unfolds. Expect temperatures to rise to around 83 degrees, perfect for those wishing to embrace the last remnants of summer. The southwest breeze may seem gentle, but it carries the promise of adventure, inviting residents to venture out. Attire should strike a balance between comfort and preparation; lightweight layers will suffice, warming up as the sun makes its ascent. With the air rich in warmth, it’s an ideal time for a stroll in the park or perhaps a visit to one of the city’s vibrant outdoor cafés, where conversations can linger like the last notes of a beloved song.
